violations.description: Syntax error in function definition prevents module parsing and execution.
violations.evidence: Line 84 of tools.py defines 'def run_ruff((self) -> str:' with an extra opening parenthesis and malformed signature, causing an immediate SyntaxError upon importing tools or executing agent.py.
violations.recommendation: Fix the function signature to 'def run_ruff(self) -> str:'.

violations.description: Documented automated test suite is missing from the repository.
violations.evidence: README.md lines 192-198 document running 'pytest' and requirements.txt pins 'pytest==9.1.1', but no tests/ directory or test files exist in the repository, causing pytest to fail with exit code 5.
violations.recommendation: Add automated unit and integration tests (e.g. under a tests/ directory) covering the CLI and tool execution logic.

violations.evidence: No CI workflow files exist (such as GitHub Actions under .github/workflows/), leaving pull requests and commits without automated testing, linting, or build checks.
violations.recommendation: Create a GitHub Actions workflow (e.g. .github/workflows/ci.yml) to automatically run Ruff linting and pytest tests on push and pull requests.

violations.description: Flawed path containment validation allows sibling directory traversal.
violations.evidence: Line 16 of tools.py uses 'if not str(target_path).startswith(str(self.repo_dir)):' to validate path traversal without appending a path separator; sibling directories with names sharing the repo directory prefix will bypass containment validation.
violations.recommendation: Use 'target_path.is_relative_to(self.repo_dir)' or ensure a trailing path separator is appended when doing string prefix matching.

violations.description: Unsanitized CLI repo argument allows option/argument injection into git clone.
violations.evidence: Line 41 of agent.py invokes subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '--depth', '1', repo_url, target_dir]) without using '--' to delimit command flags from positional arguments, allowing command option injection if repo_url starts with '-'.
violations.recommendation: Insert '--' before repo_url in the argument list to terminate option parsing, and validate repo_url format against expected URL schemes.

violations.description: Missing LICENSE file despite README advertising MIT license.
violations.evidence: Line 6 of README.md displays an MIT license badge, but no LICENSE file is present in the repository root.
violations.recommendation: Add a LICENSE file containing the full MIT License text to the repository root.
